changeSet.sql:
create or alter procedure graph.UpdateGraphTableHierarchyBy @executionId uniqueidentifier = null, @assetTypeId int = null, @assetId bigint = null as begin set nocount on;
drop table if exists #hierarchy drop table if exists #tbl drop table if exists #incoming drop table if exists #ids
create table #hierarchy ( AssetTypeID int, ID bigint, [Level] int, ParentID bigint, Code nvarchar(250) ) create clustered index CIX_TempHierarchy on #hierarchy (AssetTypeID, ID)
create table #tbl ( AssetTypeID int,
ID bigint, [Level] int, [Position] decimal(2,1),
ParentID bigint, ParentLevel int, ParentPosition decimal(2,1),
ColumnOrder int, FormattedValue nvarchar(max) ) create clustered index CIX_TempTbl on #tbl (ID) create nonclustered index IX_TempTbl on #tbl (ParentID asc, [Level] asc, ID asc) create nonclustered index IX_TempTbl_Level on #tbl ([Level] desc)
create table #incoming (ID bigint) create clustered index CIX_TempIncoming on #incoming (ID)
create table #ids (ID bigint, ParentID bigint, [Path] nvarchar(2500), Segments xml) create clustered index CIX_TempIds on #ids (ID)
if @executionId is not null begin declare @assetTypeUid uniqueidentifier select top 1 @assetTypeUid = F.AssetTypeUid from api.Execution E cross apply openjson(E.Fields, N'lax $') with (AssetTypeUid uniqueidentifier) F
if @assetTypeUid is not null begin insert into #incoming select AssetID from api.ExecutionAsset where ExecutionID = @executionId and UpdateGraph = 1; end end else if @assetTypeId is not null begin insert into #incoming select ID from Asset where AssetTypeID = @assetTypeId; end else if @assetId is not null begin insert into #incoming values (@assetId); end
if exists (select top 1 * from #incoming) begin select top 1 @assetId = ID from #incoming
declare @class int select top 1 @class = T.Class from Asset A inner join AssetType T on T.ID = A.AssetTypeID and A.ID = @assetId;
with ascendants as ( select A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, I.Object, I.ObjectID, I.Subject as ParentObject, I.SubjectID as ParentObjectID, A.Code, 1 as [Level] from Asset A inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Object = A.Object and I.ObjectID = A.ObjectID inner join #incoming O on O.ID = A.ID union all select A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.Object, A.ObjectID, I.Subject as ParentObject, I.SubjectID as ParentObjectID, A.Code, c.[Level]-1 as [Level] from ascendants c inner join Asset A on c.ParentObject = A.Object and c.ParentObjectID = A.ObjectID outer apply ( select I.Subject, I.SubjectID from PredicateIntersect I where I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Object = A.Object and I.ObjectID = A.ObjectID ) I ), descendants as ( select A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.Object, A.ObjectID, cast(null as varchar(50)) as ParentObject, cast(null as int) as ParentObjectID, A.Code, 1 as [Level] from Asset A inner join #incoming O on O.ID = A.ID union all select A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.Object, A.ObjectID, I.Subject as ParentObject, I.SubjectID as ParentObjectID, A.Code, c.[Level]+1 as [Level] from descendants c inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.PredicateType in (3,4) and I.Subject = c.Object and I.SubjectID = c.ObjectID inner join Asset A on I.Object = A.Object and I.ObjectID = A.ObjectID where c.[Level] <= 25 )
insert into #hierarchy (AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], ParentID, Code) select A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.[Level], P.ID, A.Code from ascendants A left join Asset P on P.Object = A.ParentObject and P.ObjectID = A.ParentObjectID union select A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.[Level], P.ID, A.Code from descendants A left join Asset P on P.Object = A.ParentObject and P.ObjectID = A.ParentObjectID
if @class = 9 begin insert into #tbl (AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], cast(cast([Level] as varchar) + '.1' as decimal(2,1)) as Position, ParentID, [Level] - 1, 1, Code from #hierarchy end else begin insert into #tbl (AssetTypeID, ID, [Level], [Position], ParentID, ParentLevel, ColumnOrder, FormattedValue) select distinct A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.[Level], cast(cast(A.[Level] as varchar) + '.' + cast(FT.ColumnOrder as varchar) as decimal(2,1)) as Position, A.ParentID, A.[Level] - 1, FT.ColumnOrder, F.FormattedValue from #hierarchy A inner join FieldType FT on FT.AssetTypeID = A.AssetTypeID and FT.IsPartOfKey = 1 inner join Field F on F.FieldTypeID = FT.ID and F.AssetID = A.ID end
delete T from #tbl T inner join #tbl S on S.ParentID is not null and T.[Level] = S.[Level] and T.ParentID is null and S.ID = T.ID;
if exists (select top 1 * from #tbl where [Level] <> 1) begin update T set [Level] = [Level] + S.[LevelUp], [ParentLevel] = [ParentLevel] + S.[LevelUp] from #tbl T cross apply ( select abs(min([Level]))+1 as [LevelUp] from #tbl ) S end
insert into #ids (ID, ParentID) select ID, ParentID from #tbl group by ID, ParentID;
with p as ( select ID, ParentID, ( select [Level] as '@level', ColumnOrder as '@position', AssetTypeID as '@assetTypeId', ID as '@assetId', FormattedValue as 'data()' from #tbl where ID = I.ID order by Position for xml path('segment') ) as Segments, ( select top 100 percent string_agg('[' + coalesce(FormattedValue, '') + ']', '.') from #tbl where ID = I.ID --group by Position --order by Position ) as TextPath from #ids I where ParentID is null union all select I.ID, I.ParentID, p.Segments + ( select [Level] as '@level', ColumnOrder as '@position', AssetTypeID as '@assetTypeId', ID as '@assetId', FormattedValue as 'data()' from #tbl where ID = I.ID order by Position for xml path('segment') ) as Segments, p.TextPath + STUFF( ( select '.[' + coalesce(FormattedValue, '') + ']' from #tbl where ID = I.ID order by Position for xml path(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(2500)'), 1,0,'') from #ids I inner join p on p.ID = I.ParentID )
---- Now save the data you will update. update T set T.Segments = '<path>' + p.Segments + '</path>', T.[Path] = p.TextPath from #ids T inner join p on p.ID = T.ID
--select * from #ids
--Update the graph table. update T set T.[Path] = S.[Path], T.Segments = T.Segments from graph.AssetNode T inner join #ids S on S.ID = T.ID; end end
